ar: فِى السِّرِّ وَالْجَهْرِ يَاذَا الْأَمْرِ يَاللَّهُ
tr: antal qawiyyul lazii qawwaytanii biridan
fis sirri wal jahri yaa zal amri yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Fort (Al-Qawī), qui m'as fortifié avec agrément, dans le secret et le manifeste, ô Seigneur du Commandement, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Strong (Al-Qawī), Who have strengthened me with good pleasure, in secret and in the open, O Lord of the Command, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Forte (Al-Qawī), che mi hai rafforzato con compiacimento, nel segreto e nel palese, o Signore del Comando, o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ الْمَتِينُ الَّذِى قَدْ كُنْتَ لِى بِمُنًى
tr: antal matiinul lazii qad kunta lii bimunan
walaa tuwajjihu lil makruuha yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es l'Inébranlable (Al-Matīn), qui as été pour moi avec les aspirations, et Tu ne diriges pas vers moi ce qui est détestable, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Firm (Al-Matīn), Who have been for me with aspirations, and You do not turn toward me what is hateful, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Saldo (Al-Matīn), che sei stato per me con le aspirazioni, e non rivolgi verso di me ciò che è detestabile, o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ الْوَلِىُّ الَّذِى لَآ أَبْتَغِى بَدَلًا
tr: antal waliyyul lazii laa abtaghii badalan
bihi wa lii kunta bit taamiini yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Protecteur (Al-Walī), en échange de qui je ne désire aucun substitut, et pour moi Tu as été avec la sécurité, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Protector (Al-Walī), in exchange for Whom I seek no substitute, and You have been for me with safety, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Protettore (Al-Walī), in cambio del quale non desidero un sostituto, e per me sei stato con la sicurezza, o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ الْحَمِيدُ الَّذِى وَجَّهْتَ لِى نِعَمًا
tr: antal hamiidul lazii wajjahta lii nihaman
bilaa ghuruurin wa ghayril makri yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Digne de louange (Al-Ḥamīd), qui as tourné vers moi des grâces, sans illusion et sans ruse, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Praiseworthy (Al-Ḥamīd), Who have turned graces toward me, without delusion and without guile, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Degno di lode (Al-Ḥamīd), che hai rivolto verso di me grazie, senza illusione e senza inganno, o Allah.

tr: yaa muhsiyal khalqi wal ash-yaa-i jumlatihaa
kafaytanii durra maa ahsayta yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Celui qui dénombre (Al-Muḥṣī) la création et les choses toutes ensemble, Tu m'as préservé du mal de ce que Tu as dénombré, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O Reckoner (Al-Muḥṣī) of creation and of all things together, You have spared me the harm of what You have numbered, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Colui che enumera (Al-Muḥṣī) la creazione e le cose tutte quante, mi hai preservato dal danno di ciò che hai enumerato, o Allah.

tr: yaa mubdii-al khalqi yaa man laa tuwajjihu lii
maa laa uhibbu radiitu hanka yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Initiateur (Al-Mubdiʾ) de la création, ô Celui qui ne diriges pas vers moi ce que je n'aime pas : je me suis satisfait de Toi, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O Originator (Al-Mubdiʾ) of creation, O You Who do not turn toward me what I do not love: I am well pleased with You, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Iniziatore (Al-Mubdiʾ) della creazione, o Colui che non rivolgi verso di me ciò che non amo: mi sono compiaciuto di Te, o Allah.

ar: مُعِيدُ أَحْمَدَ عَوْدٍ قُدْتَّ لِى كَرَمًا
فِى كُلِّ شَهْرٍ وَيَوْمٍ فِيكَ يَاللَّهُ
tr: muhiidu ahmada hawdin qudtta lii karaman
fii kulli shahrin wa yawmin fiika yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Restaurateur (Al-Muʿīd), Tu m'as conduit par générosité le plus louable des retours, en chaque mois et chaque jour, en Toi, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O Restorer (Al-Muʿīd), You have led to me out of generosity the most praiseworthy of returns, in every month and day, in You, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Restauratore (Al-Muʿīd), mi hai condotto per generosità il più lodevole dei ritorni, in ogni mese e in ogni giorno, in Te, o Allah.

ar: مُحْيِى بِخَيْرِ حَيَاةٍ جُدْتَّ لِى أَبَدًا
tr: muhyii bikhayri hayaatin judtta lii abadan
falaka shukrii bisawfil humri yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Donateur de vie (Al-Muḥyī), d'une vie excellente Tu m'as été prodigue pour toujours : à Toi donc ma gratitude, avec la pureté de la vie, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O Giver of life (Al-Muḥyī), with the best of lives You have been lavish to me forever: so to You is my gratitude, with purity of life, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Datore di vita (Al-Muḥyī), di una vita eccellente mi sei stato prodigo per sempre: a Te dunque la mia gratitudine, con la purezza della vita, o Allah.

ar: مُمِيتُ قَدْ سُقْتَ مَوْتِى لِلْعِدَى وَلَهُمْ
tr: mumiitu qad suqta mawtii lil hidaa wa lahum
makaarihii suqta fid daarayni yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Donateur de mort (Al-Mumīt), Tu as poussé ma mort vers les ennemis, et vers eux Tu as poussé mes adversités, dans les deux Demeures, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O Giver of death (Al-Mumīt), You have driven my death toward the enemies, and toward them You have driven my adversities, in the two Abodes, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Datore di morte (Al-Mumīt), hai sospinto la mia morte verso i nemici, e verso di loro hai sospinto le mie avversità, nelle due Dimore, o Allah.

ar: يَاحَىُّ حَمْدِى وَشُكْرِى مَعْ رِضَاىَ مَعًا
tr: yaa hayyu hamdii wa shukrii mah ridaaya mahan
minniya khuzduuna sukhtin minka yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Vivant (Al-Ḥayy), ma louange et ma gratitude, avec mon agrément, accueille-les de moi sans courroux de Ta part, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O Living (Al-Ḥayy), my praise and my gratitude, together with my contentment, accept them from me without displeasure on Your part, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Vivente (Al-Ḥayy), la mia lode e la mia gratitudine, insieme al mio compiacimento, accoglile da me senza sdegno da parte Tua, o Allah.

ar: قَيُّومُ قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى مَاكُنْتُ أَطْلُبُهُ
tr: qayyuumu qad qudtta lii maa kuntu atlubuhu
bighayri kasbin ilal jannaati yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Subsistant (Al-Qayyūm), Tu m'as conduit ce que je recherchais, sans acquisition de ma part, jusqu'aux Jardins, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O Self-Subsisting (Al-Qayyūm), You have led to me what I sought, without my earning, until the Gardens, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Sussistente (Al-Qayyūm), mi hai condotto ciò che cercavo, senza mio acquisto, fino ai Giardini, o Allah.

ar: أَوْ صَلْتَ لِى وَاجِدُ الْأَثْمَانَ دُونَ عَنَآ
لَّكَ الْوُجُودُ الَّذِى لِى بَانَ يَاللَّهُ
tr: aw salta lii waajidul asmaana duuna hanaa
lakal wujuudul lazii lii baana yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu m'as fait parvenir, ô Celui qui trouve (Al-Wājid), les prix sans peine : à Toi (appartient) l'Existence qui m'est apparue, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have brought to me, O Finder (Al-Wājid), the prices without toil: Yours is the Existence that has become manifest to me, O Allah.
bayts.it: Mi hai fatto giungere, o Colui che trova (Al-Wājid), i prezzi senza fatica: a Te (appartiene) l'Esistenza che mi si è manifestata, o Allah.

tr: yaa maajiduj halniyad daarayni muhtaliyan
bighayri kibrin wa hujbin rabbi yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Noble (Al-Mājid), rends-moi élevé dans les deux Demeures, sans orgueil ni vanité, Seigneur, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O Noble (Al-Mājid), make me exalted in the two Abodes, without pride or vanity, Lord, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Nobile (Al-Mājid), rendimi elevato nelle due Dimore, senza superbia né vanità, Signore, o Allah.

tr: yaa waahiduj halniyad daarayni munfaridan
mahal munaa bihaziizi minka yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Unique (Al-Wāḥid), rends-moi singulier dans les deux Demeures, avec les aspirations, par un don précieux de Ta part, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O One (Al-Wāḥid), make me singular in the two Abodes, with aspirations, through a precious gift from You, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Unico (Al-Wāḥid), rendimi singolare nelle due Dimore, con le aspirazioni, per un dono prezioso da parte Tua, o Allah.

ar: لَكَ الْتِجَآءِى بِمَا لِى اخْتِيرَ يَاصَمَدِى
tr: lakal tijaa-ii bimaa likhtiira yaa samadii
bishran lijumlati man ahbabta yal laahu
bayts.fr: À Toi (va) mon refuge, en ce qui a été choisi pour moi, ô mon Absolu (Aṣ-Ṣamad), comme allégresse pour tous ceux que Tu as aimés, ô Allah.
bayts.en: To You (goes) my refuge, in what has been chosen for me, O my Self-Sufficient (Aṣ-Ṣamad), as gladness for all those You have loved, O Allah.
bayts.it: A Te (va) il mio rifugio, in ciò che è stato scelto per me, o mio Assoluto (Aṣ-Ṣamad), come letizia per tutti coloro che hai amato, o Allah.

tr: ardayta yaa qaadirul makhzuula munzafihan
ilaa siwaanaa lakat tahmiidu yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu as fait choir, ô Puissant (Al-Qādir), le délaissé (de Dieu), repoussé vers d'autres que nous : à Toi la louange, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have cast down, O Able (Al-Qādir), the forsaken one, driven off toward others than us: to You be praise, O Allah.
bayts.it: Hai fatto precipitare, o Potente (Al-Qādir), l'abbandonato (da Dio), respinto verso altri che noi: a Te la lode, o Allah.

tr: razaqtanil hajji tayyan anta mukhtadirun
mahal jiwaari wa zawrin fiika yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu m'as accordé le Pèlerinage par repliement (de la terre) — Tu es le Tout-Puissant — avec le voisinage (du Prophète) et la visite en Toi, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have granted me the Pilgrimage by folding (of the earth) — You are the All-Powerful — with nearness (to the Prophet) and the visit in You, O Allah.
bayts.it: Mi hai concesso il Pellegrinaggio per ripiegamento (della terra) — Tu sei l'Onnipotente — con la vicinanza (al Profeta) e la visita in Te, o Allah.

tr: antal muqaddimu qaddimnii hunaa wa ghadan
halaa kashiirin minal akh-yaari yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es Celui qui fait avancer (Al-Muqaddim) : fais-moi avancer ici-bas et demain devant beaucoup des élus, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Expediter (Al-Muqaddim): bring me forward here and tomorrow before many of the elect, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei Colui che fa avanzare (Al-Muqaddim): fammi avanzare quaggiù e domani su molti degli eletti, o Allah.

tr: antal muwaakhkhiru azhabtal hidaa wa madaw
ilaa siwaanaa mahal  khiz-yaani yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es Celui qui fait reculer (Al-Muʾakhkhir) : Tu as ôté les ennemis, et ils sont partis vers d'autres que nous, avec l'ignominie, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Delayer (Al-Muʾakhkhir): You have removed the enemies, and they went off toward others than us, with disgrace, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei Colui che fa indietreggiare (Al-Muʾakhkhir): hai tolto via i nemici, ed essi sono andati verso altri che noi, con l'ignominia, o Allah.

tr: wa innakal awwaluj halnii hunaa wa ghadan
fis saabiqiina bifadlin minka yal laahu
bayts.fr: Et en vérité Tu es le Premier (Al-Awwal) : place-moi ici-bas et demain parmi les devanciers, par grâce de Ta part, ô Allah.
bayts.en: And truly You are the First (Al-Awwal): place me here and tomorrow among the forerunners, by grace from You, O Allah.
bayts.it: E in verità Tu sei il Primo (Al-Awwal): ponimi quaggiù e domani tra i precursori, per grazia da parte Tua, o Allah.

tr: yaa aakhiruj halaniyad daarayni zaa rutabin
wa saqqi humrii ilal jannaati yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Dernier (Al-Ākhir), rends-moi doté de rangs dans les deux Demeures, et purifie ma vie jusqu'aux Jardins, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O Last (Al-Ākhir), make me possessed of ranks in the two Abodes, and purify my life until the Gardens, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Ultimo (Al-Ākhir), rendimi dotato di ranghi nelle due Dimore, e purifica la mia vita fino ai Giardini, o Allah.

tr: yaa zaahirur zuqniyal maamuula murtadiyan
hannii wa azhirniyal qur-aana yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Apparent (Aẓ-Ẓāhir), accorde-moi ce que j'espère, satisfait de moi, et fais-moi manifester le Coran, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O Manifest (Aẓ-Ẓāhir), grant me what I hope for, well pleased with me, and make me manifest the Qurʾān, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Manifesto (Aẓ-Ẓāhir), concedimi ciò che spero, compiaciuto di me, e fammi rendere manifesto il Corano, o Allah.

tr: yaa baatinur zuqniyal asraara zaa minanin
wajhal fu-aadiya zarfaz zikri yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Caché (Al-Bāṭin), accorde-moi les secrets, ô Détenteur des faveurs, et fais de mon cœur le vase du rappel, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O Hidden (Al-Bāṭin), grant me the secrets, O Possessor of favours, and make my heart the vessel of remembrance, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Nascosto (Al-Bāṭin), concedimi i segreti, o Possessore di favori, e rendi il mio cuore vaso del ricordo, o Allah.

tr: hab lii bifadlika yaa waalii muwaasalatii
khayral baraayaa wa man waalayta yal laahu
bayts.fr: Accorde-moi, par Ta grâce, ô Gouverneur (Al-Wālī), mon union avec le Meilleur des créatures et avec ceux que Tu as pris pour amis, ô Allah.
bayts.en: Grant me, by Your grace, O Governor (Al-Wālī), my union with the Best of creatures and with those You have befriended, O Allah.
bayts.it: Concedimi, per Tua grazia, o Reggente (Al-Wālī), la mia unione con il Migliore delle creature e con coloro che hai preso come amici, o Allah.

ar: إِلَى سِوَى قَصْدِ ضُرِّى الدَّهْرَ يَاللَّهُ
tr: wa innakal mutahaalii suq hidaaka mahan
ilaa siwaa qasdi durrid dahra yal laahu
bayts.fr: Et en vérité Tu es le Très-Élevé (Al-Mutaʿālī) : pousse Tes ennemis, tous ensemble, vers autre chose que le dessein de me nuire, pour toujours, ô Allah.
bayts.en: And truly You are the Supremely Exalted (Al-Mutaʿālī): drive Your enemies, all together, toward other than the aim of harming me, forever, O Allah.
bayts.it: E in verità Tu sei l'Altissimo (Al-Mutaʿālī): sospingi i Tuoi nemici, tutti insieme, verso altro che l'intento di nuocermi, per sempre, o Allah.

tr: wassih wa mallik wa ahtiq duuna maqsadatin
wa lis tajib dahwatii ya barru yal laahu
bayts.fr: Élargis, rends maître et affranchis, sans corruption, et exauce pour moi mon invocation, ô Bienfaisant (Al-Barr), ô Allah.
bayts.en: Expand, make master and set free, without corruption, and answer for me my supplication, O Beneficent (Al-Barr), O Allah.
bayts.it: Allarga, rendi padrone e affranca, senza corruzione, ed esaudisci per me la mia invocazione, o Benefico (Al-Barr), o Allah.

tr: halayya tubta mahawtaz zanba jumlatahu
tahharta kulliya yaa tawwaabu yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es revenu vers moi (en pardonnant), Tu as effacé le péché tout entier, Tu as purifié tout mon être, ô Celui qui accueille le repentir (At-Tawwāb), ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have turned to me (in forgiveness), effaced the sin entirely, purified my whole being, O Accepter of repentance (At-Tawwāb), O Allah.
bayts.it: Ti sei volto a me (perdonando), hai cancellato il peccato tutto intero, hai purificato tutto il mio essere, o Colui che accoglie il pentimento (At-Tawwāb), o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ الَّذِى مِنْ عِدَى الْإِسْلَامِ مُنْتَقِمٌ
وَلِى انْتَقَمْتَ بِمَا لِى اخْتَرتَ يَاللَّهُ
tr: antal lazii min hidal islaami muntaqimun
wa lin taqamta bimaa likhtarta yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es Celui qui, des ennemis de l'Islam, est le Vengeur (Al-Muntaqim), et pour moi Tu T'es vengé par ce que Tu as choisi pour moi, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the One Who takes vengeance (Al-Muntaqim) on the enemies of Islam, and for me You have avenged with what You chose for me, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei Colui che dei nemici dell'Islam è il Vendicatore (Al-Muntaqim), e per me Ti sei vendicato con ciò che per me hai scelto, o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ الْعَفُوُّ الَّذِى عَنِّى عَفَوْتَ بِلَآ
tr: antal hafuwwul lazii hannii hafawta bilaa
ibqaa-i haybin hadaytal kulla yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es Celui qui efface les fautes (Al-ʿAfuww), qui m'as pardonné sans laisser (aucun) défaut : Tu as guidé tout (mon être), ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Pardoner (Al-ʿAfuww), Who have pardoned me without leaving (any) fault: You have guided (my) whole (being), O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei Colui che cancella le colpe (Al-ʿAfuww), che mi hai perdonato senza lasciare (alcun) difetto: hai guidato tutto (il mio essere), o Allah.

tr: antar ra-uuful lazii haayantu ra-fatahu
walaa tuwajjihu lil ahdaa-a yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Très-Compatissant (Ar-Raʾūf), dont j'ai vu de mes yeux la compassion, et Tu ne diriges pas vers moi les ennemis, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Most Kind (Ar-Raʾūf), Whose kindness I have seen with my eyes, and You do not turn the enemies toward me, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Pietosissimo (Ar-Raʾūf), la cui pietà ho visto con i miei occhi, e non rivolgi contro di me i nemici, o Allah.

ar: يَامَالِكَ الْمُلْكِ لِى وَسَّعْتَ دُونَ جَوًى
tr: yaa maalikal mulki lii wa sahta duuna jawan
fil mulki wal malakuutid dahra yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Roi de la Royauté (Mālik al-Mulk), pour moi Tu as élargi, sans tourment, dans la Royauté et le Royaume céleste, pour toujours, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O King of Sovereignty (Mālik al-Mulk), for me You have widened, without anguish, in the Kingdom and the heavenly Dominion, forever, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Re del Regno (Mālik al-Mulk), per me hai allargato, senza struggimento, nel Regno e nel Regno celeste, per sempre, o Allah.

ar: يَاذَا الْجَلَالِ وَذَا الْإِكْرَامِ هَبْ لِىَ مَا
لِى اخْتَرْتَ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى مِنْكَ يَاللَّهُ
tr: yaa zal jalaali wa zal ikraami hab liya maa
likhtarta dunyaa wa ukhraa minka yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Détenteur de la Majesté et Détenteur de la Générosité, donne-moi ce que Tu as choisi pour moi, en ce monde et dans l'autre, de Ta part, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O Possessor of Majesty and Possessor of Generosity, grant me what You have chosen for me, in this world and the next, from You, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Possessore della Maestà e Possessore della Generosità, donami ciò che hai scelto per me, in questo mondo e nell'altro, da parte Tua, o Allah.

ar: قُدْ لِىَ يَامُقْسِطُ الْمَطْلوبَ حَيْثُ أُرَى
tr: qud liya yaa muqsitul matluuba haysu uraa
khillan wa hibban mahar ridwaani yal laahu
bayts.fr: Conduis-moi, ô Équitable (Al-Muqsiṭ), ce qui est recherché, de sorte que je sois vu (comme Ton) ami intime et bien-aimé, avec l'agrément, ô Allah.
bayts.en: Lead to me, O Equitable (Al-Muqsiṭ), what is sought, so that I be seen (as Your) intimate friend and beloved, with good pleasure, O Allah.
bayts.it: Conducimi, o Equo (Al-Muqsiṭ), ciò che è richiesto, in modo che io sia visto (come Tuo) amico intimo e amato, con il compiacimento, o Allah.

ar: عَنِّى بِكَوْبِكَ لِى فِى الْجَمْعِ يَاللَّهُ
tr: yaa jaamihuj mah liyal aghraada murtajiyan
hannii bikawnika lii fil  jamhi yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Celui qui rassemble (Al-Jāmiʿ), rassemble pour moi les desseins, satisfait de moi, par le fait que Tu sois pour moi dans le rassemblement, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O Gatherer (Al-Jāmiʿ), gather my aims for me, well pleased with me, through Your being for me in the gathering, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Colui che riunisce (Al-Jāmiʿ), riunisci per me gli scopi, compiaciuto di me, con il Tuo essere per me nella riunione, o Allah.

ar: إِلَيْكَ هَبْ لِىَ مَآ أَحْتَاجُ يَاللَّهُ
tr: antal ghaniyyul lazii laa yantamii gharadun
ilayka hab liya maa ahtaaju yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Riche (Al-Ghanī), à qui nul dessein ne se rapporte : donne-moi ce dont j'ai besoin, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Rich (Al-Ghanī), to Whom no aim pertains: grant me what I need, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Ricco (Al-Ghanī), al quale nessuno scopo è riferibile: donami ciò di cui ho bisogno, o Allah.

tr: aghnaytanii innakal mughnii bilaa sababin
fasarmadan liya kun bil fadli yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu m'as enrichi — Tu es Celui qui enrichit (Al-Mughnī) — sans cause : éternellement donc sois pour moi avec la grâce, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have enriched me — You are the Enricher (Al-Mughnī) — without cause: so forever be for me with grace, O Allah.
bayts.it: Mi hai arricchito — Tu sei l'Arricchente (Al-Mughnī) — senza causa: in eterno dunque sii per me con la grazia, o Allah.

tr: ahtaytanii innakal muhtii munal kuramaa
kafaytanii jumlatal ahdaa-i yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu m'as donné — Tu es Celui qui donne (Al-Muʿṭī) — les aspirations des nobles ; Tu m'as préservé de tous les ennemis, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have given me — You are the Giver (Al-Muʿṭī) — the aspirations of the noble; You have spared me all the enemies, O Allah.
bayts.it: Mi hai dato — Tu sei il Donatore (Al-Muʿṭī) — le aspirazioni dei nobili; mi hai preservato da tutti i nemici, o Allah.

tr: manahta yaa maanihul aswaa-a min qibalii
walaa tuwajjihu lii maasaa-a yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu as empêché, ô Préservateur (Al-Māniʿ), les maux de mon côté, et Tu ne diriges pas vers moi ce qui afflige, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have prevented, O Preventer (Al-Māniʿ), the evils from my side, and You do not turn toward me what grieves, O Allah.
bayts.it: Hai impedito, o Preservatore (Al-Māniʿ), i mali dal mio lato, e non rivolgi verso di me ciò che affligge, o Allah.

ar: مَنَعْتَ يَاضَارُ مِنِّى الضُّرَّ فِى أَبَدٍ
tr: manahta yaa daaru minnid durra fii abadin
walaa tuwajjihu lil idraara yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu as empêché, ô Celui qui nuit (Aḍ-Ḍārr), le mal de moi pour toujours, et Tu ne diriges pas vers moi la nuisance, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have prevented, O Distresser (Aḍ-Ḍārr), harm from me forever, and You do not turn harming toward me, O Allah.
bayts.it: Hai impedito, o Colui che nuoce (Aḍ-Ḍārr), il danno da me per sempre, e non rivolgi verso di me il nuocere, o Allah.

ar: لِى قُدْتَّ فِى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ نَّفْعَ ذِى كَرَمٍ
tr: lii qudtta fii kulli shay-in nafha zii karamin
yaa naafihan lizawil iimaani yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu m'as conduit en toute chose le bienfait d'un Généreux, ô Bienfaiteur (An-Nāfiʿ) de ceux qui ont la foi, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have led to me in everything the benefit of a Generous One, O Benefactor (An-Nāfiʿ) of those who have faith, O Allah.
bayts.it: Mi hai condotto in ogni cosa il beneficio di un Generoso, o Benefattore (An-Nāfiʿ) di coloro che hanno fede, o Allah.

tr: nawwarta yaa nuuru kullii saafiyan abadan
kafaytanii zulamal ash-yaa-i yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu as illuminé, ô Lumière (An-Nūr), tout mon être, pur, pour toujours ; Tu m'as préservé des ténèbres des choses, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have illumined, O Light (An-Nūr), my whole being, pure, forever; You have spared me the darkness of things, O Allah.
bayts.it: Hai illuminato, o Luce (An-Nūr), tutto il mio essere, puro, per sempre; mi hai preservato dalle tenebre delle cose, o Allah.

ar: قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى مِنْكَ يَاهَادِى هِدَايَةَ مَنْ
tr: qad qudtta lii minka yaa haadii hidaayata man
qad saahabul mustafal mukhtaari yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu m'as conduit de Ta part, ô Guide (Al-Hādī), la guidance de ceux qui ont été les compagnons de l'Élu, le Préféré, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have led to me from You, O Guide (Al-Hādī), the guidance of those who were companions of the Chosen, the Elect, O Allah.
bayts.it: Mi hai condotto da Te, o Guida (Al-Hādī), la guida di coloro che sono stati compagni dell'Eletto, il Prescelto, o Allah.

tr: antal badiihul lazii baanat badaa-ihuhu
qudttal badaa-iha lil ajri yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Créateur merveilleux (Al-Badīʿ), dont les merveilles sont apparues : Tu m'as conduit les merveilles avec la récompense, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Wondrous Originator (Al-Badīʿ), Whose wonders have appeared: You have led wonders to me with reward, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Creatore mirabile (Al-Badīʿ), le cui meraviglie sono apparse: mi hai condotto le meraviglie con la ricompensa, o Allah.

ar: لِى صَفِّ عُمْرِىَ يَابَاقِى بِخَيْرِ رِضًى
tr: lii saffi humriya yaa baaqii bikhayri ridan
waltubqinii bikitaabil laahi yal laahu
bayts.fr: Purifie pour moi ma vie, ô Éternel (Al-Bāqī), par le meilleur agrément, et fais-moi durer par le Livre d'Allah, ô Allah.
bayts.en: Purify my life for me, O Everlasting (Al-Bāqī), with the best good pleasure, and make me endure through the Book of Allah, O Allah.
bayts.it: Purifica per me la mia vita, o Eterno (Al-Bāqī), con il migliore compiacimento, e fammi perdurare con il Libro di Allah, o Allah.

ar: لِى قُدْتَّ جُمْلَةَ مَالِى اخْتَرْتَ مِنْ مِّنَنٍ
tr: lii qudtta jumlata maa likhtarta min minanin
wirasatan waarisal amwaati yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu m'as conduit l'ensemble des faveurs que Tu as choisies pour moi, en héritage, ô Héritier (Al-Wārith) des morts, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have led to me all the favours You chose for me, as an inheritance, O Inheritor (Al-Wārith) of the dead, O Allah.
bayts.it: Mi hai condotto l'insieme dei favori che hai scelto per me, in eredità, o Erede (Al-Wārith) dei morti, o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ الرَّشِيدُ الَّذِى قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى رَشَدًا
فِى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّعَ التَّبْشِيرِ يَاللَّهُ
tr: antar rashiidul lazii qad qudtta lii rashadan
fii kulli shay-in mahat tabshiiri yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Guide de la rectitude (Ar-Rashīd), qui m'as conduit la rectitude en toute chose, avec la bonne nouvelle, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Guide to the Right Path (Ar-Rashīd), Who have led to me right guidance in everything, with glad tidings, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Retto Direttore (Ar-Rashīd), che mi hai condotto la rettitudine in ogni cosa, con la buona novella, o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ الصَّبُورُ الَّذِى وَجَّهْتَ لِى ثَمَنًا
tr: antas sabuurul lazii wajjahta lii samanan
wa qad zahabta bimaa aabaahu yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Patient (Aṣ-Ṣabūr), qui as tourné vers moi un prix (de récompense), et Tu as emporté ce qui le refuse, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Patient (Aṣ-Ṣabūr), Who have turned toward me a price (of reward), and You have taken away what refuses it, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Paziente (Aṣ-Ṣabūr), che hai rivolto verso di me un prezzo (di ricompensa), e hai portato via ciò che lo rifiuta, o Allah.
